entities.name: Hythonia
entities.description: A massive gorgon of Theros, known as Hythonia the Cruel, who forms her throne from petrified followers.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: The serpentine god of Theros to whom Hythonia is deeply connected.

events.summary: When Hythonia appeared on Skathos, citizens took her for an avatar of Pharika, and she formed her throne from the petrified bodies of her followers.
events.quote: Hythonia decided to form her throne out of the petrified bodies of her followers

relations.note: Deeply connected; mistaken for her avatar.
relations.quote: has a deep connection to the serpentine god Pharika
